annotations.title: FDA tobacco and vape problem reports

description: FDA tobacco and vape problem reports — FDA Center for Tobacco Products problem reports (e-cigarettes, vapes, cigarettes, cigars, smokeless): total reports, top reported health problems (e.g. seizure, shortness of breath), top product problems (e.g. overheated, exploded), product types and the most recent reports. Params: product (optional, e.g. electronic, cigarette, cigar), problem (optional keyword, e.g. seizure, exploded), limit (1-25, default 10). Source: openFDA, public domain. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: fda_tobacco_problems
